market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$103 on May 5; reports indicate WTI traded near $106 on May 1 and tested swing high $110.03 amid Iran tensions. May 4 close was $106.42. Reaching $110 high in May is highly plausible given current volatility and ongoing Strait of Hormuz disruption — likely already touched briefly.
